title: Geographic Terrain, Elevation, Water, Route, Border & Network Authoring
objective: Implement manual and precision geographic feature authoring for land/coastlines, terrain regions, contours/elevation, cliffs/ridges, water bodies, rivers, roads/trails, bridges/fords/passages, borders and other map networks while keeping visual connectivity noncanonical and owner bindings/proposals explicit.

scope.purpose: Provide manual and precision cartographic authoring of geographic terrain, elevation, water, route, border and network features over completed MCS foundations without turning visual connectivity into canonical spatial/world truth.
scope.completion_gate: Representative MCS documents can deterministically author and inspect geographic terrain/elevation/water/route/border/network projections with explicit owner bindings or proposals where needed, while visual connectivity remains noncanonical and canonical spatial/world authorities remain unchanged.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 and MCS_PROGRAM_BACKLOG.json were reconsulted after exact-tree MCS-08 publication. No cross-program rotation detour supersedes the surviving MCS strict order; MCS-10 is next selected.
MCS-08 consumes the completed MCS authoring foundations and authors cartographic geographic-feature projections only.
Visual connectivity remains noncanonical; owner bindings and binding proposals are explicit rather than inferred from drawn adjacency or connection.
MAI/SSA/World/Scene and other owner-domain spatial authorities remain authoritative; MCS-08 does not become canonical spatial-law or world-topology authority.

Concurrent owner-authorized UISK-09, UISK-10 and UISK-11 publications advanced application main while MCS-08 was active. Each stale validation base was rejected; the unchanged six-file MCS-08 delta was reconciled to fresh main and fully revalidated before publication.

The repository disallowed merge commits. While the OPS3 publication lease remained held, fresh base/head checks were repeated and the validated six-file tree was published by allowed squash merge with exact tree preservation.
MCS-10, PCA-16, MCCS, MRCS, MSAS, MNCS, SMB-08 and downstream work were not started by this execution.
next_action: MCS-08 is closed. MCS-10 is selected_not_started; wait for a later owner Continue before granting MCS-10 implementation authority.
